task.title: Dispatch canonical-review-gate workflow against base branch, not head

scope.owned_layer: The GitHub review bridge's best-effort workflow-dispatch reference for canonical review-gate rechecks.
not_changing: the review-proof tag, GitHub review, required-status, or merge-gate policy
canonical task state, supervisor runtime configuration, deployment state, or live-capital authority
composes_with: SUP-REVIEW-GATE-DISPATCH-RETRIGGER-20260805, which added the explicit recheck dispatch
the canonical-review-gate workflow on dev, which evaluates the supplied head_ref and head_sha inputs
Antigravity's independent exact-head review and the protected dev merge path

root_cause_and_change.root_cause: The bridge dispatched canonical-review-gate.yml against binding.head_branch. GitHub validates workflow_dispatch on the target ref, so a stale task branch that predates the trigger returns HTTP 422 even while dev contains the trigger; the bridge intentionally treats dispatch failure as non-fatal because the tag is the durable proof.
root_cause_and_change.change: _dispatch_canonical_review_gate_workflow now uses binding.base as the dispatch ref and continues to pass binding.head_branch and binding.head_sha as explicit workflow inputs.
root_cause_and_change.safety_property: The workflow source is resolved from the current protected base branch while the reviewed PR identity remains the exact explicit head inputs.

commands.conclusion: The approval dispatch regression asserts ref == binding.base (dev in the fixture) while preserving head_ref and head_sha inputs.
The rebased implementation diff has no whitespace errors.

commands.result: pass after rebasing implementation commit onto origin/dev@f9cf4e8f83899aac8f2b1a215e89bf92eac086fd
commands.conclusion: The task branch is based on the current dev tip at the evidence cut.

limitations: No live GitHub workflow dispatch was performed by this task worker; the regression test isolates the bridge payload and the task's accepted live incident is recorded in the task contract.
The dispatch remains best-effort by design; its failure does not erase the pushed review-proof tag.

review.instructions: Review the exact PR head that includes this manifest, bind this review_file through the governed approve command, and do not approve a later head without a new exact-head review.

acceptance.statement: The canonical-review-gate workflow dispatch targets binding.base rather than binding.head_branch.
The recheck remains bound to the reviewed PR identity through explicit head_ref and head_sha inputs.
The evidence manifest is committed before independent review and names the canonical owner/reviewer pair.

residual_risks: A GitHub API failure may still prevent the best-effort rerun; the durable review-proof tag remains available for a natural PR event or manual rerun.
Any future change to workflow input semantics must be reviewed together with this bridge contract.
